metadata.root_cause: Category 51 (Rope & strings) has class_id: null in detection_source_mapping.yaml
metadata.policy: Never declare an image with visible unlabelled litter as a hard-negative ground truth.

audited_images.qa_finding: The label file on disk is 0-byte solely because Category 51 ('Rope & strings') was assigned class_id: null in detection_source_mapping.yaml. The physical image clearly depicts discarded waste ropes/strings. Using this image as a 0-object negative would train the model to ignore visible waste.
audited_images.action_taken: Quarantined / Excluded from hard negatives pool.
